questions.def: «Withdraw» - bankomatdan pul yechib olish; «deposit» esa aksincha, pul qoʻyish.
questions.question: I need to ___ money from the ATM.

questions.def: «Interest» - qarzga olingan pul uchun toʻlanadigan qoʻshimcha haq, yaʼni foiz.
questions.question: What does interest mean?

questions.def: «Loan» va «credit» ikkisi ham qarzga berilgan pul maʼnosini beradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for loan?

questions.def: Bankda «open an account» - hisob raqam ochmoq; bu turgʻun birikma.
questions.question: I want to open a ___ at the bank so I can save my salary there.

questions.def: «Lend» - qarz bermoq, «borrow» - qarz olmoq; shuning uchun ular antonim.
questions.question: What is the opposite of lend?

questions.def: Hisob-kitoblar bilan «pay the bills» ishlatiladi, yaʼni toʻlovni amalga oshirmoq.
questions.question: I need to ___ my bills online.

questions.def: «Balance» - hisobda qolgan pul miqdori.
questions.correct: The amount of money in an account
options: The amount of money in an account
questions.question: What does balance mean?

questions.def: «Fee» ham «charge» ham xizmat uchun olinadigan haq maʼnosini beradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for fee?

questions.def: «Transfer money» - pulni bir hisobdan boshqasiga oʻtkazmoq.
questions.question: transfer ___

questions.def: «Rich» - boy, «poor» - kambagʻal; «wealthy» esa sinonim, antonim emas.
questions.question: What is the opposite of rich?

questions.def: Investitsiyadan keladigan foyda «return» deyiladi: «a high return on investment».
questions.question: I got a high ___ on my investment.

questions.def: «Budget» - pulni qanday sarflashni belgilovchi reja.
questions.question: What does budget mean?

questions.def: Moliyada «debt» va «liability» - toʻlanishi shart boʻlgan majburiyat.
questions.question: What is a synonym for debt?

questions.def: «Save up» - pulni asta-sekin jamgʻarmoq; phrasal verb «up» bilan keladi.
questions.question: save ___ money

questions.def: «Profit» - foyda, «loss» - zarar; qolgan variantlar foydaning sinonimlari.
questions.question: What is the opposite of profit?

questions.def: «Interest rate» - turgʻun birikma, foiz stavkasi degan maʼnoni beradi.
questions.question: The ___ rate is very high now.

questions.def: «ATM» - Automated Teller Machine qisqartmasi, yaʼni bankomat.
questions.question: What does ATM mean?

questions.def: «Income» va «earnings» ikkisi ham ishlab topilgan daromadni bildiradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for income?

questions.def: Hisobni yopish uchun «make a payment» - toʻlovni amalga oshirmoq deyiladi.
questions.question: You can use the bank app to make a ___ for your electricity bill.

questions.def: Pulni ishga qoʻyish «invest», uni qaytarib olish «withdraw» - shuning uchun antonim.
questions.question: What is the opposite of invest?

questions.def: «Check your balance» - hisobdagi pul miqdorini tekshirib koʻrmoq.
questions.question: I need to ___ my account balance.

questions.def: «Currency» - biror davlatda amalda boʻlgan pul birligi.
questions.correct: The money used in a country
options: The money used in a country
questions.question: What does currency mean?

questions.def: «Bankrupt» va «insolvent» - qarzini toʻlay olmaydigan, toʻlovga layoqatsiz.
questions.question: What is a synonym for bankrupt?

questions.def: «Apply for» - murojaat qilmoq; kredit bilan aynan «for» predlogi keladi.
questions.question: apply ___ a loan

questions.def: «Expensive» - qimmat, «cheap» - arzon; «costly» esa sinonim.
questions.question: What is the opposite of expensive?

questions.def: «Deposit» - hisobga pul qoʻymoq; «withdraw» esa pul yechib olmoq.
questions.question: I need to ___ some money into my account.

questions.def: «Mortgage» - uy sotib olish uchun olinadigan uzoq muddatli kredit.
questions.correct: A loan to buy a house
options: A loan to buy a house
A loan to buy a car
A loan to start a business
questions.question: What does mortgage mean?

questions.def: «Customer» va «client» ikkisi ham xizmatdan foydalanuvchi mijozni bildiradi.
questions.question: What is a synonym for customer?

questions.def: «Take out a loan» - turgʻun birikma: kredit olmoq.
questions.question: take ___ a loan

questions.def: Hisobda «credit» pul kirimi, «debit» pul chiqimi; shuning uchun qarama-qarshi.
questions.question: What is the opposite of credit?
